settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Import calendars, adjust your garage and preferences
settings.carsInGarageDesc: Mark the cars you already own. These are used to calculate which series you can race without buying anything.
settings.tracksIHaveDesc: Mark the tracks you've purchased. Used for overlap analysis and to see how many series you can race.
settings.importDesc: Download the official iRacing PDF with the season calendar and upload it here. The system automatically extracts the series and tracks for overlap analysis.
settings.dropHint: Drag the PDF here or click
settings.syncDesc: When the iRacing API is available, this updates the names, prices and classes of existing cars and tracks, and adds any new ones. If the API isn't connected, nothing changes.
settings.resetDesc: Restores the calendar to its default (2026 S2 data bundled with the app). This overwrites any previous import.
settings.resetSuccess: ✅ Calendar reset with 2026 S2 season data.
